#!/usr/bin/env bash
# R1264t D2: helpers named test or read inside multi-line quoted awk and node programs are no shell definitions.
awk '
  function test(s) { return s != "" }
  function read(f) { return f }
  test($1) { print read($2) }
' file
node -e '
function test(s) { return s.length > 0; }
function read(s) { return s; }
console.log(test(read(process.argv[1])));
' x
